mapper.select: SELECT installation_id FROM plugin_installation WHERE installation_id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT options_json FROM installation_script_options WHERE installation_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE installation_script_options SET options_json=CAST(#{json} AS JSON),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE installation_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT variable_json FROM installation_script_variable WHERE installation_id=#{id} ORDER BY name_key,variable_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE installation_script_variable SET name_key=#{nameKey},variable_json=CAST(#{json} AS JSON),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE installation_id=#{id} AND variable_id=#{variableId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM installation_script_variable WHERE installation_id=#{id} AND variable_id=#{variableId}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) FROM job_script_options o JOIN job j ON j.id=o.job_id JOIN plugin_installation i ON i.installation_id=j.plugin_installation_id WHERE i.deleted=FALSE AND (COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(o.options_json,'$.arguments'),0)>0 OR COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(o.options_json,'$.environment'),0)>0) AND j.plugin_installation_id=#{id} ORDER BY j.id
